messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT/PROD: High queue depth on dedicated pool prod-ded-3. 95th latency >300ms, queue growing. Affected routes: /v1/generate (customer-facing), /v1/embeddings. Potentially impacting customers: CorpX, NovaAnalytics. Pager: P0.

kevin_oncall: Ack. I'm on it — grabbing logs and current autoscale state.

maria_ops: @kevin_oncall I'm working on verifying whether any recent deploy touched autoscaler heuristics. Will check rollout history.

kevin_oncall: Quick snapshot: prod-ded-3 nodes=12, target_util=0.75, current_util=0.92. Autoscale is in conservative mode (max_replicas=20). Burst capacity is currently OFF for this pool.

jules_eng: If autoscale is already at 12 and util is 0.92, we should enable burst headroom while we let autoscaler ramp. Suggest temporary burst + immediate soft rate-limits for heavy customers.

mike_sre: Agreed. Plan: 1) enable burst capacity on prod-ded-3 2) apply emergency per-customer rate limits for top noisy customers 3) shape background workloads (batch/embeddings) to lower priority.

olivia_cs: Noted customer impact: CorpX reports elevated tail latency, some 503s. NovaAnalytics showing slow embeddings. I'll ping corp teams and inform them we're applying mitigation and will follow up.

kevin_oncall: Doing burst toggle now. Command (admin):
```
# enable burst capacity with +4 headroom replicas
rbctl pool update --id prod-ded-3 --enable-burst true --burst-headroom 4 --reason "emergency surge 3895001234"
```
Executing...

pagerduty-bot: Action logged by kevin_oncall at 3895001258.

kevin_oncall: Burst enabled. New target max replicas = 16. Spinning up warm nodes, ETA ~90s.

jules_eng: While nodes spin, let's apply a soft token bucket per-customer throttle for generate endpoints to avoid queue blowup. For now: CorpX 60req/s -> 30req/s; NovaAnalytics embeddings 30req/s -> 15req/s. Use traffic-control API.

mike_sre: Applying throttles:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/traffic-controls \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' \
  -d '{"pool":"prod-ded-3","controls":[{"customer":"CorpX","route":"/v1/generate","limit_rps":30,"mode":"soft"},{"customer":"NovaAnalytics","route":"/v1/embeddings","limit_rps":15,"mode":"soft"}]}'
```
Responses: 202 Accepted. Controls active.

kevin_oncall: Observing queue depth dropping. 30s after burst: queue down 40%, p95 latency falling to ~180ms.

olivia_cs: Updating customers: told CorpX & NovaAnalytics we're applying emergency throttle and enabling extra capacity; we expect improvement in ~2min. They thanked us and asked for ETA for full resolution.

raj_sales: Any customer-facing banner or status page update needed? I can post a brief note on status.redwood if you want.

maria_ops: Yes please post a short status note: "Investigating high latency affecting some customers on dedicated pool prod-ded-3. Temporary throttles and extra capacity applied. Working on mitigation; updates shortly." Keep it non-technical.

raj_sales: Will do. Posting now.

mike_sre: One more mitigation: demote non-urgent background jobs hitting this pool. Setting embed-job-priority=low for known batch jobs.

jules_eng: Also flagging a deploy from earlier (rev: service-gen v2.14.3) that changed batching defaults. Maria, can you roll back batching config if needed?

maria_ops: I'm pulling the rollout. If rollback looks risky, we can patch config to restore previous batch_size. Checking canary metrics.

kevin_oncall: On-call handover incoming: @maria_ops I'll hand off after next 15m once we confirm stability. Please acknowledge when you take over.

maria_ops: Acknowledged — I'll take over at 3895001350 unless you need more time.

pagerduty-bot: Note: handoff scheduled: kevin_oncall -> maria_ops at 3895001350.

kevin_oncall: Metrics update: 120s after burst enable + throttles: p95 generate latency = 120ms, error rate down from 3.4% to 0.6%. Queue depth stabilized. Nodes up: 15/16. Looks good.

olivia_cs: Customers report improvement. CorpX says latency is acceptable now. NovaAnalytics confirms embeddings back to normal.

mike_sre: Keep throttles in soft mode for 20 minutes, then incrementally relax if no regression. Also add short-term alert suppress for this pager to avoid noise while we observe.

kevin_oncall: Suppressing duplicate pager alerts for prod-ded-3 for 10m.

jules_eng: Follow-up actions (to be tracked):
- Postmortem entry with timeline and root cause hypothesis (possible batching config + spike)
- Evaluate autoscaler tuning for faster ramp or smarter prediction
- Add automated safe-burst policy for pools hitting sustained >0.85 util
- Review routing policies so heavy embeddings can be diverted to dedicated ded-emb pool if available

maria_ops: Taking over. I'll keep this thread updated and create the incident doc with initial timeline. Thanks team.

kevin_oncall: Handoff complete. Thanks all.

olivia_cs: Noting follow-up: schedule customer post-incident calls for CorpX.

pagerduty-bot: Incident status: mitigation in place, monitoring. Incident state: DECLARED -> MITIGATING. Logged timeline id: INC3895001234.

maria_ops: Last check at 3895001499: stable metrics for 5m, error rate ~0.5%, p95 <160ms. Leaving throttles in place for 10 more minutes then gradual rollback. Will file RCA and link here.

raj_sales: Thanks everyone, especially on-call. I'll coordinate customer comms after RCA.
